description: Virte measures where your time actually goes: a timer you start, blocks you log, and automatic measurement on your computer and phone. Connected to ChatGPT, it answers how your day, week or month went, with the total measured and the split by area of life, and it shows your calendar, open tasks, habits, goals, journal, notes and money. The numbers are the same ones you see inside the Virte app. You can also take care of Virte from the conversation: create tasks and reminders, log time you already spent, start and stop the timer, mark a habit, record an expense, fix the date of a task or the area of a time block, and delete what went in wrong. Anything that deletes asks you to confirm first, and notes locked with your password are never read. Requires a Virte account with an active subscription.

defaultPrompt: What do I have to do today?
How much time did I study this month?
